newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell another 17 percent in Bull.
newsitem.headline: France to sell another 17 percent in Bull.

text.p: The French government will sell another 17 percent in computer maker Cie des Machines Bull and details of the operation will be announced during a Bull shareholders' meeting on Thursday afternoon, a source said.
France to sell another 17 percent in Bull =2
At Bull, a spokesman confirmed that the state would reduce its stake but he said that the amount of 17 percent was not correct. He declined to give details.
The state has a stake of 30.5 percent while France Telecom has a stake of 18.7 percent. Motorola, NEC also have 18.7 percent while Dai Nippon Printing has 5.8 percent.
IBM has 0.7 percent, Bull staff 3.5 percent and 3.4 percent is traded on the market.
